about: Known facts about the CBN corpus snapshot (.dist/rag-evaluation/corpus.json, captured 2026-10-03), read from each document's own text, plus synthetic letters for cases the snapshot lacks. Every check is a must or must-not assertion. Checks marked "model": true depend on the language model and are skipped with --offline. Run: python scripts/evaluate_graph_extraction.py [--offline] [--case ID].

mapping.about: A pilot MFB workspace (unit licence) uploads its own policy, procedure and records (tests/evals/graph_fixtures). Iroko must extract the controls, suggest which library requirements each addresses and which records evidence them, and must not map related-sounding or out-of-library material. Every check depends on the model; run with --mapping (not available with --offline).

chat.about: After the mapping run, the pilot admin confirms the suggestions the gold set expects, records an owner, and then a 2026 letter amends the 2017 BVN circular. The real chat agent then answers the pilot's five questions, plus one with the graph unavailable. Checks follow scripts/evaluate_conversations.py check_turn, plus record citations and the graph trace step. Run with --chat (needs --mapping).

change.title: Amendment to the BVN Enrolment Circular (2026)
pages:
CENTRAL BANK OF NIGERIA
Other Financial Institutions Supervision Department

Ref: OFI/DIR/CIR/GEN/26/001

September 1, 2026

# LETTER TO ALL OTHER FINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS (OFIs)

This circular hereby amends circular OFI/DIR/CIR/GEN/17/139 on BVN enrollment so that BVN
awareness notices are displayed in every banking hall and on each institution's website.

Please be guided accordingly.

turns.question: How does the CBN BVN enrolment circular relate to our KYC procedure?
The BVN enrolment requirement changed. Which of our controls need reviewing?
Which requirements don't have supporting evidence in our records?
Who owns the AML/CFT returns requirement, and what is due next?
Trace the post no debit requirement: our control, its evidence and the review history.
How does the CBN BVN enrolment circular relate to our KYC procedure?

cases.why: The first BVN enrolment circular: a list of duties under 'all OFIs are required to:' and a withdrawal ban dated for that duty alone.

checks.why: 'Effective August 1, 2017' dates the withdrawal ban, not the circular.

checks.quote: Enroll their customers on or before July 31, 2017
Conspicuously display notices sensitizing customers on BVN
Ensure that all new customers have BVN
schedule of customer accounts with BVN on August 7, 2017
shall not be allowed to make withdrawals
The BVN is expected to also minimize the incidence of fraud
it has become necessary to extend the BVN enrollment
In view of the foregoing, all OFIs are required to:

cases.why: Extends the 2017 deadline. The citation and the extension are in different sentences, so the extension can only be suggested; the earlier letter's duties are restated as history.

checks.why: Only a stated or confirmed change is a library change event.
August 1, 2017 is reported from the earlier letter; January 1st, 2018 dates one requirement.

checks.quote: Ensure that all customers are enrolled on the BVN platform
Continue with the submission of progress reports on BVN enrolment on a monthly basis
Forward to Director, Other Financial Institutions Supervision Department the schedule
checks.why: Restates what the earlier letter required.

checks.quote: a. Enroll their customers on or before July 31, 2017
checks.why: Restates an expired deadline from the earlier letter.

cases.why: Follows the extension without citing it by reference; takes effect immediately; its own reference sits below a department-name heading.

checks.why: No reference number names the extension letter.
'this directive takes effect immediately': the date printed on the letter.

checks.quote: place all accounts without BVN on a 'post no debit' status

cases.why: AML/CFT returns letter: cites a 2012 circular not in the library and the MLPA '(as amended)'; the date is in an OCR page-header comment.

checks.why: '(as amended)' describes the Act; it is not this letter amending it.

checks.quote: a NIL return shall be rendered
on or before the 14th day after the end of every reporting month

cases.why: 'Further to our circular ref ...' cites the 2017 letter; it does not amend or replace it.
Extends the BOFIA s.27 deadline for 2019 accounts; unrelated to the BDC accounts letter despite the shared subject.

checks.why: A shared subject is not a relationship.

checks.quote: submit the 2019 Audited Financial Statements on or before July 31, 2020

cases.why: Addressed to bureaux de change only; names its source guidelines by title, never by reference.

checks.quote: every licensed BDC shall submit its audited financial statements
no BDC shall publish its audited accounts
all BDCs are required to submit hard copies

cases.why: DFI-only letter with numbered duties under 'DFIs are required to:' (OCR escapes the numbers as '1\.').

checks.quote: provide comprehensive disclosures on all subsidiaries and SPV operations
Submit returns on all SPVs
Report on the Financial soundness indicators
Present for approval, its Audited accounts
Meet a consolidated leverage ratio of at least 10%
A consolidated risk-based examination of all subsidiaries
checks.why: What the regulator itself will do.

cases.why: A deadline counted from the date of the letter, and a title that names a prohibition.

must be liquidated within 90 days of the date of this letter
PROHIBITION OF PLACEMENT/INVESTMENT IN FUNDS MANAGED BY UNINSURED ENTITIES

checks.quote: implement the above resolution and disseminate same to all their branches

checks.quote: The underlining criteria is that your bank must be the one that registered the person for BVN

Payment licences are not OFIs: a PSB/MMO circular never reaches an MFB, and OFI circulars never reach PSBs.
